title: Native gate evidence parses coloured cargo output
goal: Hosted CI exports CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always, so the native gate's outer-suite parser saw no 'Running' lines and real_native_cargo_gates_accept_a_passing_fixture failed on main (Test root-cli hash:2/3) and in the v0.21.44 release suite. Gate commands run with colour off and the parser strips ANSI sequences.
